description: Trained on synthetic, fictional history only (see src/predict/history.ts). Probabilities are model outputs; none are hard-coded.

exception.title: Invoice exception probability
exception.question: Will this invoice need an exception resolved by a person?

data.split: chronological split by invoice date: oldest 60% train, next 20% validation, newest 20% test (2025-01-01 to 2026-10-30; 8000 rows)

cause.title: Likely root cause
cause.question: If this invoice has an exception, what is the most likely cause?

data.split: chronological split by invoice date: oldest 60% train, next 20% validation, newest 20% test (2025-01-01 to 2026-10-30; 1576 rows); trained on exception invoices only

delay.title: Payment delay risk
delay.question: Will payment be made after the due date?

data.split: chronological split by invoice date: oldest 60% train, next 20% validation, newest 20% test (2025-01-01 to 2026-10-30; 8000 rows)

supplierRisk.title: Supplier disruption risk
supplierRisk.question: Will this supplier disrupt supply (late or failed deliveries) within 90 days?

data.split: grouped by supplier: 60% of suppliers train, 20% validation, 20% test (200 suppliers x 12 monthly snapshots); no supplier is in two parts
